note: Glossary of every tool in the web app: one entry per tool with a name, the words users type for it (aliases) and a short plain-text description. It feeds the assistant's system prompt and the offline fallback that answers 'what is ...' questions without the language model.

tools.name: Grayscale
tools.description: Converts the image to a single-band grayscale image using a luminance-weighted combination of the color channels.

tools.name: Negative
tools.description: Inverts pixel values to produce a photographic negative.

tools.name: Laplacian
tools.description: Edge detection filter that highlights areas of rapid intensity change, such as boundaries and fine detail.

tools.name: Brightness
tools.description: Shifts all pixel values by a constant amount from -255 to 255; positive values brighten the image and negative values darken it; results are limited to the valid 0 to 255 range.

tools.name: Threshold
tools.description: Each color value (red, green, blue) above the threshold is set to its maximum, and all others are set to zero.

tools.name: Mean filter
tools.description: Smooths the image by averaging neighboring pixels.

tools.name: Clear result
tools.description: Clears the result viewport. The original image and the undo history are not affected.

tools.name: K-Means
tools.description: Groups the image's pixels into K clusters (2 to 20) by colour. Each cluster reports its grey range, its centroid colour and how much of the image it covers, and the run produces a clustered display image plus a raw label map.

tools.name: Classification ranges and Generate map
tools.description: The Clusters table lists each K-Means cluster with its greyscale range, name, colour and share of the image. You can rename a cluster, recolour it and edit its minimum and maximum; the ranges stay linked so neighbours follow each other and the two ends stay locked to 0 and 255. Generate map applies those ranges and colours to the image and opens the Map composer with the classified result.

tools.name: Map composer
tools.description: Composes the image with its title, legend, scale bar, north arrow and credit line on one canvas. The preview is exactly what the exported PNG contains (1x, 2x or 3x), and the legend names and colours stay in sync with the Clusters table.

tools.name: Histogram
tools.description: Shows how the pixel intensities of an image are distributed across 256 bins, with the minimum, maximum, mean, standard deviation and pixel count. Each window can switch between linear and log scale, smooth the bins, show the red, green or blue channel (or all three together), compare against another image and export the chart as a PNG.

tools.name: Distance
tools.description: Measures the distance between the two points you click on a viewport. Choose pixels, millimetres, centimetres, metres, kilometres, inches, feet or miles, and give the ground length of one pixel when the image carries no scale; the measurement appears as one line in the Analysis section.

tools.name: Satellite fetch
tools.description: Fetches a Sentinel-2 true-colour crop either for a place name or for two corner coordinates, with optional start and end dates. Requests are limited to 5 km of ground and the imagery arrives at 10 m per pixel, so the distance tool and the map scale bar know its real ground size.

tools.name: Undo and Redo
tools.description: Undo steps back through the last 15 operations and Redo repeats what you undid. Both live in the Edit menu and on Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y, and the result viewport is painted from a copy kept in the browser, so stepping back needs no new request.
